create_mnist_dataset: create a tf.data.Dataset pipeline that loads MNIST images, preprocesses them to float32 [-1, 1], and batches them
run_train_step: run a single training step using GradientTape to compute gradients and apply SGD optimizer updates
run_train_epoch: run a full training epoch over a dataset using tf.function for graph-compiled iteration
test_model_accuracy: test a model's accuracy on a test dataset by computing prediction correctness and returning accuracy percentage
build_convnet_model: build a sequential convnet model with two Conv2D layers, ReLU activations, Flatten, and a Linear output layer
